interest: Japanese propaganda via 'patriotic kimonos,' stamp collectors and leaflets, and anti-espionage campaigns tied to the 1940 Olympics.
overview: List of Papers for 894.202 (Japanese Espionage and Propaganda), August 1934–March 1938: naval pamphlets, 'patriotic kimonos,' Olympic anti-espionage campaigns, and leaflet drops over Chefoo.

people.name: Erle R. Dickover
people.role: First Secretary of U.S. Embassy in Tokyo

people.name: Addison E. Southard
people.role: U.S. Consul General at Hong Kong

people.name: J. B. Emmert
people.role: Philatelist and recipient of propaganda correspondence

people.name: Tan Ko Heng
people.role: Clerk at the American Consulate in Taikoku

subfiles.about: Naval intelligence report regarding Japanese propaganda and anti-foreign activities abroad, noting patriotic kimonos sold in Kobe department stores.
subfiles.summary: Naval Attaché report (August 20, 1934) on Japanese propaganda, including 'patriotic kimonos' sold in Kobe department stores.
subfiles.title: Report from Naval Attaché Japan on Propaganda and Patriotic Kimonos

subfiles.about: Consular despatch from Kobe reporting on patriotic kimonos on sale in local department stores.
subfiles.summary: Consul Howard Donovan reports 'patriotic kimonos' on sale in Kobe department stores, October 30, 1934.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 396 from Donovan (Kobe) on Patriotic Kimonos

subfiles.about: Telegram reporting that the Japanese Navy announced the international distribution of 10,000 propaganda pamphlets.
subfiles.summary: Grew reports the Japanese Navy sent 10,000 propaganda pamphlets abroad on December 3, 1934.
subfiles.title: Telegram No. 268 from Grew (Tokyo) on Japanese Naval Propaganda

subfiles.about: Military intelligence report detailing the propaganda and intelligence activities of the Japanese Military Attaché in Rome.
subfiles.summary: Military Attaché Rome reports on Japanese Military Attaché propaganda and intelligence activities in Italy, November 1934.
subfiles.title: Report No. 14150 from Military Attaché Rome on Japanese Propaganda in Italy

subfiles.about: Voluntary consular report from Osaka detailing Japanese intelligence gathering methods.
subfiles.summary: Fred E. Lukes reports from Osaka on Japanese intelligence methods, March 15, 1935.
subfiles.title: Voluntary Report from Lukes (Osaka) on Japanese Intelligence Methods

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a report from France enclosing a Cyrano newspaper article on the Japanese Secret Service.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Dawson's Report W.D. 1584 (August 1935) enclosing a Cyrano article on the Japanese Secret Service.
subfiles.title: Special Report No. W.D. 1584 from Dawson on Japanese Secret Service

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a despatch on anti-espionage campaigns warning Japanese women against foreign contacts ahead of the 1940 Olympics.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Dickover's Despatch No. 2060 (1936): Olympic-linked anti-espionage campaign to protect Japanese women from foreigners.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2060 from Dickover on Anti-Espionage and 1940 Olympics

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a despatch reporting on propaganda sent to a foreign philatelist in the Far East.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Southard's Hong Kong Despatch No. 63 (1937) on Japanese propaganda sent through philatelic correspondence.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 63 from Southard on Propaganda via Philatelic Correspondence

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a communication transmitting an English-language Japanese pamphlet on the Sino-Japanese conflict.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Donald Himmons's January 1938 letter enclosing a Japanese pamphlet justifying the China conflict.
subfiles.title: Communication from Himmons Transmitting Propaganda Pamphlet

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a report on the Japanese occupation of Chefoo and aerial dissemination of evacuation leaflets.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to a Rieser Company report on Japanese leaflet drops over occupied Chefoo, February 1938.
subfiles.title: Report from Rieser Co. on Leaflet Drops at Chefoo

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a despatch from Mukden transmitting a Japanese military propaganda leaflet.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to John Paton Davies, Jr.'s February 1938 Mukden despatch enclosing a Japanese military propaganda leaflet.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Davies (Mukden) Transmitting Military Propaganda Leaflet

subfiles.about: Consular despatch from Taikoku transmitting a memorandum on an attempt to sell confidential information to a consulate clerk.
subfiles.summary: Consul Carlos J. Warner reports from Taikoku that a Japanese national tried to sell 'information' to the consulate, February 1938.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Warner (Taikoku) on Attempted Sale of Information

subfiles.about: Consular despatch from Osaka to the Tokyo Embassy enclosing a report on Japanese anti-spy measures.
subfiles.summary: George A. Makinson sends from Osaka a report on Japanese anti-espionage laws and security measures, March 30, 1938.
subfiles.title: Despatch from Makinson (Osaka) on Japanese Anti-Spy Measures

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet for a despatch from Grew on the Tokyo Wartime Thought-Control Exhibit with an enclosed press clipping.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference to Grew's Despatch No. 2799 (March 1938) on Tokyo's 'Wartime-Thought Control Exhibit.'
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 2799 from Grew on Wartime Thought-Control Exhibit
